gameplay.access_control: Zones cover buildings, premises and individual units; business permissions are bounded by the current occupancy and leased unit.
gameplay.audit: Key issue registers, visitor controls, contractor authorisation, lost credential revocation and emergency override audit policies are defined; runtime events are created during play.
gameplay.credential_boundary: Credentials are assigned to organisations/groups only. No named person credentials, employees, residents or population records are created.
gameplay.finance_boundary: No invoices, payments, asset purchases or financial postings are created.
gameplay.life_safety: Emergency egress remains mechanically available; security controls do not obstruct designated egress.
gameplay.physical_security: Every canonical access point has a door/gate and lock record, with mechanical key control or an electronic controller as appropriate.
